content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bakersfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Verify you meet these thresholds before enrolling. Bakersfield's oil & gas, agriculture, healthcare, and construction sectors all employ PMP-certified professionals; confirm your role qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all scheduled sessions from your Bakersfield location—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full PMI-mandated curriculum covering project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure. You'll receive a Certificate of Completion upon finishing.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete the formal PMP application, documenting your education and project-management experience. Submit payment of the PMI exam fee. PMI may audit your background; respond promptly to any requests. Processing typically takes several weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials, practice tests, and review sessions to master the exam content. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. The exam is computer-based and available at testing centers in the Bakersfield area. Apply your training and experience to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification lasts three years. During each renewal cycle, earn the required professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or published work in project management. Renew with PMI before your certificate expires to keep your credential active and competitive in Bakersfield's job market.
